mn132:4.2: You muster delight there, thinking that you had such form in the past; you muster delight there, thinking that you had such feeling in the past; you muster delight there, thinking that you had such perception in the past; you muster delight there, thinking that you had such choices in the past; you muster delight there, thinking that you had such consciousness in the past—
mn132:4.3: That’s how you run back to the past.
mn132:5.2: You don’t muster delight there, thinking that you had such form in the past; you don’t muster delight there, thinking that you had such feeling in the past; you don’t muster delight there, thinking that you had such perception in the past; you don’t muster delight there, thinking that you had such choices in the past; you don’t muster delight there, thinking that you had such consciousness in the past—
mn132:5.3: That’s how you don’t run back to the past.
mn132:6.2: You muster delight there, thinking that you may have such form in the future; such feeling …
mn132:6.5: you muster delight there, thinking that you may have such consciousness in the future—
mn132:6.6: That’s how you anticipate the future.
mn132:7.2: You don’t muster delight there, thinking that you may have such form in the future; such feeling …
mn132:7.5: you don’t muster delight there, thinking that you may have such consciousness in the future—
mn132:7.6: That’s how you don’t anticipate the future.
mn132:8.2: Take an unlearned ordinary person who has not seen the noble ones, and is neither skilled nor trained in the teaching of the noble ones, who has not seen true persons, and is neither skilled nor trained in the teaching of the true persons.
mn132:8.3: They regard form as self, self as having form, form in self, or self in form;
mn132:8.7: consciousness as self, self as having consciousness, consciousness in self, or self in consciousness—
mn132:8.8: That’s how you falter amid presently arisen phenomena.
mn132:9.2: Take a learned noble disciple who has seen the noble ones, and is skilled and trained in the teaching of the noble ones, who has seen true persons, and is skilled and trained in the teaching of the true persons.
mn132:9.3: They don’t regard form as self, nor self as having form, nor form in self, nor self in form;
mn132:9.7: nor consciousness as self, nor self as having consciousness, nor consciousness in self, nor self in consciousness—
mn132:10.6: you clearly discern in every case.
mn132:10.9: Today’s the day to keenly work—
mn132:10.10: who knows, tomorrow may bring death!
mn132:10.11: For there is no bargain to be struck
mn132:10.12: with Death and his mighty horde.
mn132:10.13: One who keenly meditates like this,
mn132:12.3: that’s who has one fine night—
mn132:13-19.2: That’s how you run back to the past, Ānanda.
mn132:13-19.3: And how, Ānanda, do you not run back to the past? …
mn132:13-19.4: That’s how you don’t run back to the past, Ānanda.
mn132:13-19.5: And how, Ānanda, do you anticipate the future? …
mn132:13-19.6: That’s how you anticipate the future, Ānanda.
mn132:13-19.7: And how, Ānanda, do you not anticipate the future? …
mn132:13-19.8: That’s how you don’t anticipate the future, Ānanda.
mn132:13-19.9: And how, Ānanda, do you falter amid presently arisen phenomena? …
mn132:13-19.10: That’s how you falter amid presently arisen phenomena, Ānanda.
mn132:13-19.11: And how, Ānanda, do you not falter amid presently arisen phenomena? …
mn132:13-19.12: That’s how you don’t falter amid presently arisen phenomena, Ānanda.
mn132:13-19.15: that’s who has one fine night—
mn132:13-19.19: Ānanda and One Fine Night is finished—the second.
